Marafon-Beccaccino is characteristic of the Italian province of Romagna. It is a four-player partnership game based on Tressette with the addition of a trump suit. The first printed reference to Beccaccino appears in 1971 in Libero Ercolani's Vocabolario romagnolo-italiano (Ravenna). Earlier the game was known as "tri sett cun el taj" (Tressette with cutting). The composite name Marafon-Beccaccino was coined in Alteo Dolcini's Il Principe di Romagna (Imola, 1975), which codified official rules.
